bugs_in_compose1: No fallback mechanism for missing clips - fails hard with RuntimeError if clips don't exist or are corrupt
No pilot fallback (build_final.py has this but PILOT file doesn't exist anyway)
CLIP_DURATION_S = 10 hardcoded assumption; clips_for_section derives clip count from target/10 without verifying those clips exist on disk first
Does not validate that the derived clip files actually exist before probe_ok (probe_ok catches it but error message could be clearer)
Resumable skip logic uses target - 1.0 tolerance which may skip segments that are slightly short
bugs_in_build_final: PILOT fallback at line 62 is dead code - PILOT file does not exist
clips_for() only checks file size > 100KB, not actual video validity/duration
Arbitrary limit of 3 clips per section (found[:3]) discards additional clips
norm_long() loops clips to fill duration - introduces quality loss from re-encoding loop and potential timing drift
Assertion at line 67 (abs(d-target)<1.0) may fail for norm_long path due to loop/trim imprecision; 1s tolerance is tight for looped content
Hardcoded Windows font path (C:/Windows/Fonts/arialbd.ttf) - not portable
No pre-processing integrity probe on clips before ffmpeg work
Lower encoding quality: crf 20, veryfast preset vs _compose1's crf 18, medium preset
SRT path not escaped for Windows in subtitles filter - will fail on Windows with spaces/colons in path
anullsrc base track created but narration placement uses adelay on each track - correct but _compose2 fixes amix to properly include base track
Monolithic single file - harder to maintain/test

architecture._compose1: Split into two modules (_compose1.py + _compose2.py) with clean separation: video assembly vs audio/subtitles/final encode

video_processing._compose1: Direct trim per clip: each clip trimmed to target_dur/n_clips, scaled/cropped individually, then concat. No re-encoding loops. Higher quality (crf 18, medium). Pre-probes every clip for integrity (>=4s).
video_processing.build_final: norm_long(): normalize clip -> loop n times -> trim to target. Re-encodes twice. Lower quality (crf 20, veryfast). Takes max 3 clips. No pre-probe.

clip_selection._compose1: Derives clip count from target_duration / 10s, expects clips named {sid}-0.mp4, {sid}-1.mp4, etc. Uses ALL derived clips.
clip_selection.build_final: Discovers clips on disk with glob, filters by size > 100KB, takes FIRST 3 only.

fallback_strategy._compose1: None - requires all clips to exist and be valid
fallback_strategy.build_final: Three-tier: real clips (max 3) -> PILOT (dead, file missing) -> generated cover card (PIL)

audio_handling._compose1: Delegates to _compose2.add_audio_and_mix(): creates silent base from script.total_duration_seconds, places each narration at section start_seconds via adelay, amix includes base track correctly (fixed in _compose2). loudnorm applied.
audio_handling.build_final: Similar approach inline. Creates silent base from script.total_duration_seconds, adelay per narration, amix. loudnorm applied. _compose2 has the fix for amix input count.

srt_handling._compose1: Delegates to _compose2.build_subtitles(): uses section start_seconds/end_seconds and section text. Properly escapes Windows paths for subtitles filter (_escape_subtitle_path).
srt_handling.build_final: Inline SRT generation using same timing/text. NO Windows path escaping - will fail on Windows if path has spaces or drive letter colon.

cover_card_fallback.build_final: Generates colored card with PIL: section ID, label, and text wrapped. Uses hardcoded font and color palette.

pilot_fallback.build_final: Present at line 62-63 but PILOT file does not exist - dead code

error_handling._compose1: Probes every clip before ffmpeg work; clear error messages with remediation hint
error_handling.build_final: Only checks file size; generic error messages

reporting._compose1: Detailed render_report.json with per-section actual vs target, spec, subtitles path

assertion_line_67_analysis.will_it_pass_for_all_sections: UNLIKELY - norm_long's loop+trim approach introduces timing variance. For cover card path it will pass (exact duration). For real clips path, the double re-encode (normalize -> loop -> trim) and concat copy can drift. 1 second tolerance is tight for 10-30s sections.
assertion_line_67_analysis.risk_sections: Sections using norm_long with real clips (most sections if clips exist)

srt_approach_in_compose1.format: Standard SRT with 1-based index, HH:MM:SS,mmm --> HH:MM:SS,mmm, text, blank line
srt_approach_in_compose1.windows_escape: YES - _escape_subtitle_path() handles drive letter colon and spaces

reasoning: Pre-flight integrity probe on every clip prevents silent corruption
Proper Windows path escaping for subtitles filter (critical for Windows)
Correct amix filter graph including base track (fixed in _compose2)
Resumable builds with valid segment detection
Detailed render report with per-section metrics
No dead code (unlike build_final's missing PILOT)

recommended_fix_for_chosen_composer.add_fallback_mechanism: Add a cover card generator to _compose1/_compose2 (or new _compose3) that activates when clips_for_section returns missing/corrupt clips. Use PIL similar to build_final.card() but make font path configurable via env var or config file.
recommended_fix_for_chosen_composer.make_clip_discovery_robust: Modify clips_for_section to glob actual files on disk (like build_final.clips_for) but KEEP the integrity probe. Derive clip list from existing files, not from target_duration/10 assumption.
recommended_fix_for_chosen_composer.handle_missing_clips_gracefully: In build_section_segment, if clips list is empty or all clips fail probe, generate cover card segment instead of raising RuntimeError.
recommended_fix_for_chosen_composer.optional_pilot_fallback: If PILOT file exists, use it as last resort before cover card. Keep the check but don't assume it exists.
recommended_fix_for_chosen_composer.configurable_encoding: Move crf/preset to constants at top for easy tuning.
recommended_fix_for_chosen_composer.remove_dead_code: No PILOT fallback needed unless file is actually provided.
